_comment: SHR-006. Numeric and count claims made on public surfaces, each bound to evidence. Scope is deliberately narrow: NUMBERS ONLY. Prose claims ('local-first', 'privacy-first', 'no hosted dependency') are already gated by shiroe/release/claim_gate.py and are NOT duplicated here — two gates over one claim is how they drift apart. machine_verified claims are recomputed on every test run by scripts/check-canon-consistency.py using pure-stdlib verifiers (no subprocess, no network); a mismatch against evidence_value is a claim-drift finding. command_attested claims name the command a human must run. manual claims name a file a human must read. Any claim whose status is not 'verified' must name an owner, a resolving PR, and why it is still open.

claims.why_unverified: Withdrawn from README.md rather than re-pinned. Nothing regenerates the README, so a hardcoded count is stale the next time a test lands -- this one drifted twice (979 -> 1179 tests, 82 -> 94 files) and produced a canon finding each time. The Python matrix on that row carries the information a reader needs; the counts carried drift.
